Key gaps: no run_event/run persistence in PGlite (blocks the target run-trace/inspector); no platform/ layer by name; two markdown renderers; no Flat 2.0 style gate (630 border idioms, STABLE not regressing — a claimed +143 regression was retracted as a grep artifact). WARNINGS carried: coverage gate is RED today (19.45% vs 60% threshold) and 153/153 tests pass, both of which a rebuild puts at risk; rank-1 design authority (knowme-ui-ux-standard.md) is absent from this repo, living only in hybrid-mobile-architecture-src. Analyze MUST resolve Open Questions 8 (primitive-library conflict) and 9 (is services/+stores/+protocols already platform/ under other names) before any change list — both change the shape of the work. No global rebuild-vs-strangler verdict is asserted; evidence supports per-surface scoping.
